topic: Demonstration and explanation on the correct procedures of connecting the towing arm to A/C and tractor and movement of aircraft with proper positioning of safety numbers and choke man i.a.w INAP-2 article.
syllabus_extract: Demonstration and explanation on the correct procedures of connecting the towing arm to A/C and tractor and movement of aircraft with proper positioning of safety numbers and choke man i.a.w INAP-2 article.
specific_objectives: 21.1.7.1 Trainee will be able to explain procedure on movement of A/C from hangar to dispersal.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of towing arm connection, safety number positioning, and choke man placement under instructor supervision.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of the towing arm?
Where are safety numbers typically located on the aircraft?
What is the role of the choke man during aircraft movement?

topics: Correct attachment of towing arm to tractor
development.content:
Pre-flight inspection of towing equipment
Correct attachment of towing arm to tractor
Safety number positioning guidelines
Choke man positioning and responsibilities
Communication signals for movement

Step-by-step connection procedure
Verification of safety number placement
Choke man safety protocols
Tractor pushback alignment
Emergency stop procedures

Movement from hangar to dispersal
Final safety check before release
Post-movement equipment stowage
Reporting discrepancies found
Review of INAP-2 article compliance

summary_questions: Explain the correct sequence for connecting the towing arm to the aircraft.
Describe the responsibilities of the choke man during aircraft movement.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief summary of the towing arm connection procedure to be discussed in LP 12 regarding GSE maintenance.

pft_rows.syllabus: Demonstration and explanation on the various GSEs required on dispersal for flying activity and flight servicing, GSE maintenance. Schedule & record of inspections carried out, Calibration of GSE (as applicable) and record of calibration.
